We apply ROUGE F1 to evaluate text summarization, BLEU for table-to-text. For dialogue generation, we report the perplexity of generating reference response y to evaluate informativeness. We also use FactCC and QuestEval for factuality and PARENT for table-to-text faithfulness.

For text summarization, since previous works report the unreliability of existing factual metrics, we report two different types of metrics, FactCC (CC) based on textual entailment and QuestEval (QE) based on question answering, for reliable comparison.
